About

About

I started MBBS at BPKIHS in 2024 and I'm now in third year, working through Internal Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Surgery and Forensic Medicine.

Outside the wards I teach chemistry, speak at Dharan Toastmasters, take photographs in manual mode, and design posters and graphics for the events I help organise.
